scripts.predev: npm run build -w @neorest/core && npm run build -w @neorest/router-core && npm run build -w @neorest/router-node && npm run build -w neorest
scripts.dev: npm run predev && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev --workspace=@neorest/rooms-api" "npm:dev --workspace=@neorest/rooms-web"
